title: flatfile
description: The result of classifying a filesystem path along the file -> regular-file -> flatfile spine (classifyFlatfile). A flatfile is exactly a NUL-free regular file: isRegularFile is true and binarity is "flat". binarity and kind are null when the path is not a regular file (a directory, symlink, device, etc.) -- binarity sniffing and flatfile-vs-binary-file classification presuppose a regular file and are never attempted otherwise. This schema describes the plain classification value itself, never a charged/holographic reading of the path -- that composition belongs to the stat/observation row of the decomposition.

isRegularFile.description: Whether the path names a regular file (node:fs statSync(path).isFile()).

binarity.description: The sniffed binarity of the file's leading bytes (first 8192), or null when the path is not a regular file.

kind.description: "flatfile" when the path is a regular file whose binarity is "flat"; "binary-file" when it is a regular file whose binarity is "binary"; null when the path is not a regular file.
